name: Shenzhen Ampron Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen Ampron Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, manufacture, sale, and service of sensors in China. It offers force sensors, MEMS pressure sensors, ceramic capacitive pressure sensors, glass micro-melt pressure sensors, oxygen sensors, nitrogen and oxygen sensors, temperature sensors, PTC thermistors, NTC thermistors, and gas and flow sensors. The company also involved in the Manufacturing, processing, and sales of electronic components; research and development and sales of electronic components, sensors, and integrated circuit chips; retail and wholesale of electronic components.
